Q: Use a Macro to add a value from one cell to another cell A:

If you will be using the function as a custom function, add return HomeScore before the last }.

If you will be running it from another place, your script should first grab the destination range, then use setValue(value), i.e.,

PossessionSim.getRange("A1").setValue(HomeScore);

Q: How to create a universal solution for working with databases using Delphi Community Edition? A:

I wanted to share my thoughts regarding the Delphi platform. While Delphi has a rich history and a loyal user base, it is no longer seen as a forward-looking platform. Its continued existence largely depends on long-standing clients who have historically relied on the tool.

Unfortunately, Delphi is not suitable for building universal database solutions, especially within the constraints of its free version. The Community Edition is heavily restricted, making it unlikely to attract startups or younger developers.

It’s truly sad to watch a once-beloved tool fade away, but the reality is that Delphi’s future is uncertain. The next generation of young developers—the very future of technology—is not embracing it, and without their adoption, the platform’s long-term viability is in question.
